headline: Cloud and Infrastructure Engineer | Security and DevOps
summary: Cloud and infrastructure focused computer science student with experience in AWS automation, security hardening, and virtualization. Built SIEM analytics pipelines, automated infrastructure with Terraform and Ansible, and supported enterprise identity and networking operations. Interested in cloud, security, and infrastructure roles.

employment.title: SQL Server and Azure Intern
bullets: Developed and optimized T-SQL queries and stored procedures, improving data retrieval efficiency across relational datasets.
Performed database maintenance tasks including indexing, backups, and performance tuning to ensure reliability and scalability.
Supported Azure data migrations and built ETL pipelines using Azure SQL and related services.

employment.title: Freelance Engineer
bullets: Led migration from WordPress on Bluehost to a serverless Next.js + Firebase architecture across AWS and GCP, managing DNS, SSL, and production cutover.
Designed branch-based CI/CD pipelines with isolated dev/prod environments enabling zero-downtime deployments.
Engineered secure architecture using Firestore RBAC, centralized secrets management with GCP Secret Manager, and SSR/SSG caching optimizations, reducing database operations by about 30%.

employment.title: IT Intern - Technician
bullets: Administered Active Directory lifecycle management, including provisioning, deprovisioning, and role-based access control across enterprise systems.
Resolved Tier 2/3 infrastructure issues across county offices, troubleshooting identity, endpoint, and network configuration failures.
Managed hardware deployment, inventory tracking, and enterprise software licensing across multiple locations.

projects.name: CometSentinal
projects.description: AI-powered SIEM analytics platform for log-based threat detection.
bullets: Built an AI-powered security analytics platform processing log data to detect 32 threats across 13+ datasets.
Designed a multi-stage LLM pipeline with MITRE ATT&CK and CVE enrichment, achieving about 80-90% detection accuracy.
Reduced analysis latency by about 85% (2 min to 15-20 sec) through pipeline optimization and efficient data processing.

projects.name: TexSAW Capture the Flag (First Place)
projects.description: University CTF competition focused on security challenges.
bullets: Secured first place in the university division for two consecutive years, outperforming 500+ teams.
Used tools like John the Ripper, Ghidra, and online cipher cracking tools to solve CTF challenges.
Achieved a career-high ranking of 30th worldwide in 2026 among 500 teams.

projects.name: AWS Cloud Infrastructure Automation Lab
projects.description: Automated AWS infrastructure provisioning and compliance hardening.
bullets: Designed and deployed automated AWS infrastructure environments using Terraform, Jenkins, Docker, and Ansible.
Provisioned and managed EC2, IAM, S3, VPCs, subnets, route tables, security groups, and networking configurations.
Built CI/CD pipelines for automated provisioning and configuration management workflows.
Hardened Linux EC2 environments using OpenSCAP compliance scans and automated baselines.
Implemented IaC best practices using reusable Terraform modules and version-controlled deployments.

projects.name: Lab Setup (VMware and Citrix Cloud)
projects.description: Enterprise-style on-prem lab across Dell PowerEdge servers.
bullets: Built an on-prem lab across three Dell PowerEdge servers with RAID 0/1/5 storage configurations.
Deployed VMware ESXi and vCenter for centralized virtualization and resource orchestration.
Configured Windows Server 2019 with Active Directory, DNS, and DHCP.
Implemented Citrix XenServer and XenDesktop for VDI provisioning and virtual app delivery.

projects.name: Library Catalog Project
projects.description: Full-stack library catalog web app with team collaboration.
bullets: Managed an 8-person team across frontend, backend, database, and middleware tasks.
Built a MySQL-backed web interface for book search and check-in/check-out.
Created a T3 Stack app (Next.js, tRPC, Drizzle, Clerk, Tailwind) pulling data from MySQL.
Created a virtual network using ZeroTier for team collaboration and concurrent development.
